comparison.objective: Hold a nail upright while the other arm hammers it until self-supporting; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization under repeated impacts is shared, but nail holding and hammer striking differ from recessed fastener use, collar adjustment, and calibration.
comparison.success_condition: Nail must become self-supporting and the holding arm must clear the hammer; candidate must avoid hard-stop impact while achieving two repeatable damped cycles and retained setting.
comparison.reason: Impact exposure is only a generic commonality; construction fastening and damper tuning test different abilities.
